title: Fake-DOM move: prompt-section-preserve / -task-mode / -recommend-url / -look-alike onto loadWorld
description:
Plan piece 4, second half: the lighter prompt-section suites. If the census names any other `prompt-section-*` file not covered by another subtask, it belongs here too.

Move `prompt-section-preserve.test.js`, `prompt-section-task-mode.test.js`, `prompt-section-recommend-url.test.js` and `prompt-section-look-alike.test.js` onto `loadWorld`, using the idioms the prompt-section-go probe settled. Split into two PRs if a red in one suite would block the others. `scrollTop`/`scrollHeight` on `-preserve` are expandos, not layout. The `<select>.value` throw is a stop, as in the other prompt-section subtasks.

**Done when:** each moved suite has the same test names and counts, assertion maps with mutations where it reads fake internals, its findings classified, and its file off the census list. A stopped suite stays on the list, and the PR gives the reason.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

comments.body: LIN-4266 merged (PR #2299, `56f9b474`). Its gate statement recommends continuing the prompt-section family. The ticket and review say this ticket should not be dispatched as written until the parent LIN-4255 has re-planned it or explicitly accepted that recommendation.

**Hold lifted: LIN-4255 has accepted the continuation.** The 14:13Z note on this ticket held dispatch until LIN-4255 re-planned or explicitly accepted LIN-4266's recommendation to continue the prompt-section family. LIN-4255's 14:22:58Z autopilot ruling does that: "continue, as written, no re-plan", with the reason that the probe did not trigger the stop rule (no new fake API needed, one session, 30 test names unchanged). It ends with "Releasing LIN-4267, LIN-4268, LIN-4269 now."

The recommender still reads this ticket's own thread only and reports `blocked`, so I am proceeding with the implementation step. Carry the LIN-4255 ruling into the work: before porting each suite, check for presses on undrawn controls and for stubs that ignore their arguments; if a suite needs an API the shared fake does not model (`getBoundingClientRect`, `style`, scroll, `<select>.value`), that suite stops and is reported with the reason, and the fake is not widened. Per LIN-4255's 13:25Z note, a moved suite leaves `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and joins the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list.

LIN-4268 beat 1/4 — ground, branch, baseline, probe, assertion map (no suite ported yet).

Branch: feat/lin-4268-fake-dom-prompt-section-light-suites from origin/main 473cc865. Census on main: 55 files, 43 tests green.
Test counts at HEAD: preserve 5, task-mode 23, recommend-url 2, look-alike 3 = 33 (the ticket's 27 is stale; 880 lines is correct). Baseline outputs saved outside the repo under /private/tmp/claude-504/lin4268-baseline/.

PROBE DECISIONS
- prompt-section-preserve: GO (5). `__autopilot__` is never drawn; use `__autopilot_stepper__` for the result-display tests (same kind:'autopilot' branch).
- prompt-section-task-mode: STOP (23). The dispatch tests reach `<select>.value` through the real disclosure: prompt-section.js:2714-2715 readDispatchExecControls(panel) -> common.js:1758-1763 select.value; fake-dom.js:329 throws. The suite's stub readDispatchExecControls: () => ({}) would hide that read by ignoring its argument, so the fake is not widened and the suite stays on the census. Also undrawn presses (run-step/cli disabled after a result, next-step only drawn idle, setup run-step/dispatch only drawn with dispatch off) and a disclosure stub that draws no data-action button.
- prompt-section-recommend-url: GO (2). __ai__ is drawn in idle.
- prompt-section-look-alike: GO (3). Setup press is drawn; positive control uses __autopilot_stepper__; the sink press keeps __autopilot__ on purpose.

No layout API (getBoundingClientRect, style, scroll) is read by any of the four. preserve's scrollTop/scrollHeight are expandos (production writes them at prompt-section.js:2236 under a stubbed pin check).

Full probe findings and the planned assertion map (mutation targets at 473cc865; measured in beat 3) are in /private/tmp/claude-504/lin4268/beat1-probe-and-assertion-map.md. Summary of the map for the three GO suites:
- preserve: P2/P5 suppression keyed on proxyForce (line ~779); P4 forced copy (2635/2669); P6 pin-before-mutate (~2218).
- recommend-url: R2 drop source param (~2111).
- look-alike: L2/L3 markdown-sink guard (MARKDOWN_SINK, line 859); L5/L6 toggle bound per paint (850-852) by node identity.

Open before beat 2: whether Go's startRun records task-mode run-task/press like the label path (line 2532). Not needed for the three GO suites.

CONFIRMATION: the probe ran in a scratch harness only. No repo file was edited. The only write made was this ticket's status (In Progress).

LIN-4268 beat 4/4: PR is open for review. Not merged, not Done.

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2302
Head SHA: 69a7fc79541c6bd1a9281a340e80fe1afb75ab83

Branch: feat/lin-4268-fake-dom-prompt-section-light-suites, four commits on 473cc865: ee9421ec (recommend-url and look-alike), cb032e9e (preserve), 69a7fc79 (census 55 -> 52 and fake-dom.js consumer list).

CI on 69a7fc79 (run 42047829084), all success: Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan (source), CI success.

Full unit suite (npm run test:unit) on 69a7fc79: 23,608 tests, 0 fail.

Census: 55 -> 52. prompt-section-task-mode stays on the census (stopped on the <select>.value read via readDispatchExecControls). The 7 container.querySelector guards in prompt-section.js are untouched.

**Autopilot (stepper) run summary, implementation arc for LIN-4268.** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2302, head `69a7fc79541c6bd1a9281a340e80fe1afb75ab83`. Not merged; review is next.

Hold: the 14:13Z hold on this ticket was lifted by LIN-4255's 14:22:58Z ruling (continue the prompt-section family, no re-plan); recorded in the "Hold lifted" comment above. The recommender still said `blocked` until that comment was posted.

Beats (one warm worker session, 4 beats, all judged on evidence before advancing):
1. Ground, branch, baseline, probe: branch from `473cc865`, baselines saved, probe verdicts per suite, assertion map. Result: preserve / recommend-url / look-alike GO; task-mode STOP on the `<select>.value` read (readDispatchExecControls, prompt-section.js:2714-2715 -> common.js:1758-1763), per the ruling's stop rule.
2. recommend-url + look-alike ported: `ee9421ec`. Mutations R2, L2/L3, L5/L6 measured red, source restored.
3. preserve ported: `cb032e9e`. Mutations P2, P4, P5, P6 measured red. Challenge sent on the unclassified `esc is not a function` probe finding: classified as a harness artefact, with evidence.
4. Census 55 -> 52 and the fake-dom.js consumer list: `69a7fc79`. Full unit suite 23,608 / 0 fail. CI on the head SHA: Unit tests, E2E 1-4/4, Secret scan, CI success, all success.

Verified by me, not taken from the worker's report: PR open, not draft, head SHA matches; five files changed (three suites, the census list with 3 deletions and no assertion edits, the fake-dom.js header); every check on the head SHA is green; the PR body carries the per-suite table, names diffs, mutation table and red classification.

What holds: 3 suites moved with names/counts unchanged (5, 2, 3); task-mode (23 tests) is untouched and stays on the census with its reason; the fake was not widened; the 7 `container.querySelector` guards are untouched.
What is left: independent review, then close-out (merge, Done). Note for review: the ticket's "27 tests" was stale (actual 33). The P5 replacement was strengthened because the original autopilot-labelled test would also pass under a label-keyed suppression; that is by reading the original, not measured.

## Review — LIN-4268

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2302 at head `69a7fc79541c6bd1a9281a340e80fe1afb75ab83` (base `473cc865`, still origin/main, so the base has not moved).

CI: green on 69a7fc79 (run 42047829084: Unit tests, E2E 1/4–4/4, Secret scan, CI success).

**Scope vs. plan.** The PR changes 5 files: the three moved suites, `fake-dom-census.test.js` (3 deletions only) and the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list. This matches beat 1's GO/STOP split. `prompt-section-task-mode.test.js` is untouched and stays on the census. The PR body gives the reason: `<select>.value` via `readDispatchExecControls`, prompt-section.js:2714 → common.js:1758. The fake was not widened, `public/prompt-section.js` is untouched, and so are the 7 `container.querySelector` guards. The hand-written container and `vm` sandbox are gone from all three suites. No rulings exist for this anchor.

**Regression check.** None of the touched files has a commit since ticket creation other than LIN-4266/4270/4265 (fake/world plumbing, all already in base) and this PR's own three commits. Nothing re-applies a revert.

**Names/counts (re-run by me).** I ran `node --test --test-reporter=spec` on base and head for preserve (5), recommend-url (2), look-alike (3), task-mode (23), fake-dom-census and fake-dom. The name diff is empty for every file, with 0 fails.

**Mutation check (re-run by me on `public/prompt-section.js`, restored after each; `git status` clean):**
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1 suppression keyed on label (`isForced = isAutopilotLabel(label)`, :779) | preserve "keyed on proxyForce" **red** (this strengthened P5 is real) |
| M2 suppression off (:779) | preserve tests 1 and 4 **red** |
| M3 copy `force=false` (:2635) | preserve "copy forces…" **red** |
| M4 pin sampled after the body write (:2218) | preserve LIN-2987 **red** |
| M4b drop `if (wasPinned) body.scrollTop = …` | preserve LIN-2987 **red** (the new expando assertion) |
| M5 drop `params.set('source', …)` (:2110) | recommend-url "source present" **red** |
| M6 drop `if (btn.closest(MARKDOWN_SINK)) return;` (:2512) | look-alike tests 1 and 2 **red** |
| M8 per-paint `ProxyToggle.bind` removed (:852) | look-alike test 3 **red** |
| **M7 header-scoped selector loosened to `'.prompt-proxy-toggle'` (:851)** | **all green on head**. The base version of the test goes **red** under the same mutation, because it pinned the `:scope > .swipe-prompt-header > …` selector via `c.queries`. |

M7 is a lost guard. The original assertion read a fake internal (`c.queries`, the selector string). Its replacement (`bound.every(b => b === toggle)`) can't tell the scoped selector from an unscoped one, because the default `promptMarkup` ('TEMPLATE PROMPT') draws no look-alike toggle in the sink. So the LIN-3401 property "a +proxy look-alike in rendered markdown is not bound" is no longer pinned. The PR's L5/L6 row measured only bind-removal (M8). I checked a fix in a scratch test (deleted): with `promptMarkup: '<button class="prompt-proxy-toggle">+proxy</button>'` the same identity assertion goes **red** under M7 (`bound 2`) and **green** on clean source.

**Other reads.** Preserve test 1 and look-alike's positive control press `__autopilot_stepper__` instead of the undrawn `__autopilot__`. Both labels take the same `isAutopilotLabel` branch (:2078), the result still renders AUTOPILOT PROMPT, and M1/M2 go red, so this is a legitimate drawn-control swap, not a loosening. `spyOnBodyWrites` wraps the element-class setter and restores it in `finally`, so the fake model is unchanged. The `esc is not a function` harness-artefact classification is well evidenced (common.js:37 is always loaded first).

**Isolated or one of a class?** The class is: a move replaces a selector-literal assertion on fake internals with a node-identity check whose fixture has no look-alike, so a scope mutation can't be told apart. In this ticket the only instance is look-alike test 3; the other replaced fake-internal reads (slot, body, order, innerHTML) all go red above. The same idiom may recur in the sibling moves (LIN-4267/4269/4271). That is **outside** this ticket (each sibling bounds its own suites), and it is a note for their reviews, not a ledger item here.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (this ticket's Done-when: "assertion maps with mutations where it reads fake internals", look-alike L5/L6): the header-only scoping of the +proxy bind (prompt-section.js:851) is not guarded by the moved suite. M7 stays green. **Settle before the merge:** in `tests/unit/prompt-section-look-alike.test.js`, test "every paint binds the +proxy toggle through the header template chain only", change `load()` to `load({ promptMarkup: '<button class="prompt-proxy-toggle">+proxy</button>' })`. Before the existing assertions, add `assert.ok(c.querySelector('[data-prompt-body] .prompt-proxy-toggle'), 'the look-alike toggle is drawn in the markdown sink');`. Keep the existing `bound.every(b => b === toggle)` assertion. The distinguishing condition is to replace the selector at :851 with `'.prompt-proxy-toggle'`: the test must go red (bound includes the sink node), and on clean source it must be green. Restore the source afterwards. Test name and count stay unchanged (look-alike 3). Add the M7 row to the PR's mutation table.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The move is complete and correct (names and counts unchanged, census 55 → 52, task-mode stop recorded, fake not widened, 8 of 9 mutations red). Close-out must make the one named test-fixture fix so the look-alike +proxy scoping guard lost in the move goes red under M7 again, then re-check CI on the new head before merging.

## Close-out — LIN-4268

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2302, squash commit `8369461cd1cd263c84225294f523db641d8bb6e3`, pinned with `--match-head-commit bcb1eb9288986083fc4e1b970f8078cabd3e59d3`. Review verdict was Approve, conditional on the ledger item below.

**What landed:** `prompt-section-preserve` (5), `-recommend-url` (2) and `-look-alike` (3) moved onto `loadWorld`, with test names and counts unchanged. The census went 55 → 52 and the `fake-dom.js` consumer list is updated. `prompt-section-task-mode` (23) is stopped and stays on the census because of the `<select>.value` read via `readDispatchExecControls` (prompt-section.js:2714 → common.js:1758). The fake was not widened.

**Change I made after the approval (one commit):**
- `bcb1eb92`: in `tests/unit/prompt-section-look-alike.test.js`, test 3 now loads `promptMarkup: '<button class="prompt-proxy-toggle">+proxy</button>'`. It also asserts that the look-alike toggle is drawn in `[data-prompt-body]`, and keeps the `bound.every(b => b === toggle)` assertion. This answers the review's M7 / "What CI Did Not Prove" item. The test name and count are unchanged (3). The PR body's mutation table has an M7 row and a follow-up note.

**Ledger (one item, inside):** the header-only scoping of the +proxy bind (prompt-section.js:851) was unguarded.
- Settled by a check I ran, using the exact distinguishing precondition review named. With the selector at :851 loosened to `'.prompt-proxy-toggle'`, look-alike test 3 goes **red** (`bound only the header toggle, every time`) and the other two stay green.
- On clean source all 3 tests are green.
- `public/prompt-section.js` was restored afterwards (`git checkout`, `git status` showed only the test file modified).

**Outside items:** none. Review noted that the same idiom (a selector-literal assertion replaced by a node-identity check on a fixture that can't tell the cases apart) may recur in LIN-4267, LIN-4269 and LIN-4271. Review put that in those tickets' own reviews, not here, so I filed nothing.

**CI:** present (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). Run 42050305967 on `bcb1eb92` was all green: Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan (source), CI success. Merged on that read.

**Deploy and post-deploy:** none needed. The PR changes only test files, the census list and a `fake-dom.js` header comment. No production code changed.

**Description archive and prune:** skipped. The description holds no embedded plan, research or scoping sections to prune (the plan lives on LIN-4255), so no edit was made.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4272 (census close-out) stays Todo. Its census count now has 52 entries, and `prompt-section-task-mode` is the stopped entry from this piece.
